title: a FIXME decide on an outcomes plan names the answer door
intention: On an outcomes-shaped plan, `cairn rehearse <id> --decide "FIXME <k>"` refuses before anything is built, naming the door that answers a kick-back (inspector.py --answer-fixme), instead of appending a claimless outcome the cast shape check then refuses.
why: Measured 2026-11-18: on dda0e72b9c67 three --decide 'FIXME n' calls were refused 'outcomes[3] has no claim', a symptom of the door's own append, and the builder spent a peer round trip learning that e1d5's inspector door is where a shaped plan answers a FIXME.
traces_to: Law 1 (a settled answer, which door answers a FIXME, was re-derived) and Law 7 (the refusal named its own write's symptom, not the caller's error).
how: In rehearsal.decide's 'FIXME <k>' arm, when lines_key(doc) == 'outcomes' and no live line stands at that step, raise Refused naming `python3 cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py --answer-fixme <id> <k> "<text>" --by <who>`, after the writes_to/reads requirement and before the shape check; nothing is written. Narrow the docstring's FIXME append to decisions plans. Red-first proof over a scratch commons, copying the idiom of test_a_decide_line_on_a_shaped_plan_carries_its_paths.py.
constraints: a decisions plan's 'FIXME <k>' decide appends its line exactly as before
decide's 'D<n>' rewrite and 'unlisted: <text>' append are unchanged on both plan shapes
rehearsal writes no state file: the FIXME answer stays build_inspector.answer_fixme's alone

outcomes.claim: decide(step='FIXME 1', writes_to, reads) on an outcomes-plan ticket with a fixme list in a scratch commons raises Refused whose text names 'inspector.py --answer-fixme', and the ticket file's bytes are unchanged
the same decide on a decisions-plan ticket in a scratch commons still appends its 'FIXME 1' line

measured.saw: rehearse --decide 'FIXME 1..3' on dda0e72b9c67 refused 'outcomes[3] has no claim (awaiting judgement is the migration's state, never a cast's); nothing written'
the same refusal on main efbeeb267 after e1d5f00a2b6c PROVED, ticket bytes unchanged; e1d5 touched only inspector.py
measured.how: decide_repro.sh: rehearsal.decide over a scratch commons holding dda0's ticket and the store charter, scratch HOME
